arxiv-2201-08062.title: A stabilizer-free C 0 C^{0} weak Galerkin method for the biharmonic equations
arxiv-2201-08062.creator: Peng Zhu, Shenglan Xie, Xiaoshen Wang
arxiv-2201-08062.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Peng Zhu, Shenglan Xie, Xiaoshen Wang. In this article, we present and analyze a stabilizer-free C 0 C^{0} weak Galerkin (SF-C0WG) method for solving the biharmonic problem. The SF-C0WG method is formulated in terms of cell unknowns which are C 0 C^{0} continuous piecewise polynomials of degree k + 2 k+2 with k ≥ 0 k\geq 0 and in terms of face unknowns which are discontinuous piecewise polynomials of degree k + 1 k+1 .

arxiv-2311-17954.creator: Chang Liu, Peng Hou, Anxiang Zeng, Han Yu
arxiv-2311-17954.description: Abstract Over the past decade, significant advances have been made in the field of image search for e-commerce applications. Traditional image-to-image retrieval models, which focus solely on image details such as texture, tend to overlook useful semantic information contained within the images.

arxiv-2402-15663.title: Leveraging ChatGPT in Pharmacovigilance Event Extraction: An Empirical Study
arxiv-2402-15663.creator: Zhaoyue Sun, Gabriele Pergola, Byron C. Wallace, Yulan He
arxiv-2402-15663.description: Abstract With the advent of large language models (LLMs), there has been growing interest in exploring their potential for medical applications. This research aims to investigate the ability of LLMs, specifically ChatGPT, in the context of pharmacovigilance event extraction, of which the main goal is to identify and extract adverse events or potential therapeutic events from textual medical sources.

arxiv-2405-16997.title: Program Synthesis is Σ 3 0 \Sigma_{3}^{0} -Complete Conference: ACM SIGPLAN Conference on Programming Languages; January 01–03, 2018; New York, NY, USA
arxiv-2405-16997.creator: Jinwoo Kim
arxiv-2405-16997.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jinwoo Kim. This paper considers program synthesis in the context of computational hardness, asking the question: How hard is it to determine whether a given synthesis problem has a solution or not? To answer this question, this paper studies program synthesis for a basic imperative, Turing-complete language IMP, for which this paper proves that program synthesis is Σ 3 0 \Sigma_{3}^{0} - complete in the arithmetical hierarchy.

arxiv-2502-08624.creator: Benjamin Bedert
arxiv-2502-08624.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Benjamin Bedert. A set B B is said to be sum-free if there are no x , y , z ∈ B x,y,z\in B with x + y = z x+y=z . We show that there exists a constant c > 0 c>0 such that any set A A of n n integers contains a sum-free subset A ′ A^{\prime} of size | A ′ | ⩾ n / 3 + c ​ log ⁡ log ⁡ n |A^{\prime}|\geqslant n/3+c\log\log n .

pmc-11354015.creator: Shruti Bhide, Sahaana Chandran, Namakkal S Rajasekaran, Girish C Melkani
pmc-11354015.description: Nuclear lamins, a type V intermediate filament, are crucial components of the nuclear envelope’s inner layer, maintaining nuclear integrity and mediating interactions between the nucleus and cytoplasm. Research on human iPSC-derived cells and animal models has demonstrated the importance of lamins in cardiac and skeletal muscle development and function.

pmc-11425506.title: 158 Evaluation of a multi-modal rehabilitation programme for people affected by cancer: the Active Together service
pmc-11425506.creator: Kerry Rosenthal, Gabbi Frith, Carol Keen, Anna Myers, Gail Phillips, Katie Pickering, Michael Thelwell, Liam Humphreys, Robert Copeland
pmc-11425506.description: PurposeRehabilitation (including prehabilitation) can help cancer patients prepare for and recover well from treatment, improve physical and psychological outcomes, and reduce demand on healthcare resources.Project descriptionActive Together is a novel evidence-based multi-modal rehabilitation service for patients with cancer before, during and after their treatment.

pmc-11616696.title: Predicting the pro-longevity or anti-longevity effect of model organism genes with enhanced Gaussian noise augmentation-based contrastive learning on protein–protein interaction networks
pmc-11616696.creator: Ibrahim Alsaggaf, Alex A Freitas, Cen Wan
pmc-11616696.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Ageing is a highly complex and important biological process that plays major roles in many diseases. Therefore, it is essential to better understand the molecular mechanisms of ageing-related genes. In this work, we proposed a novel enhanced Gaussian noise augmentation-based contrastive learning (EGsCL) framework to predict the pro-longevity or anti-longevity effect of four model organisms’ ageing-related genes by exploiting protein–protein interaction (PPI) networks.

pmc-12397277.title: Using deep learning to predict internalizing problems from brain structure in youth
pmc-12397277.creator: Marlee M Vandewouw, Bilal Syed, Noah Barnett, Alfredo Arias, Elizabeth Kelley, Jessica Jones, Muhammad Ayub, Alana Iaboni, Paul D Arnold, Jennifer Crosbie, Russell J Schachar, Margot J Taylor, Jason P Lerch, Evdokia Anagnostou, Azadeh Kushki
pmc-12397277.description: Internalizing problems (e.g., anxiety and depression) are associated with a wide range of adverse outcomes. While some predictors of internalizing problems are known (e.g., their frequent co-occurrence with neurodevelopmental (ND) conditions), the biological markers of internalizing problems are not well understood.

pmc-12653483.title: The Impact of OXTR, COMT, and GRIN2B Polymorphisms on Brain Development in Preterm Infants
pmc-12653483.creator: Eon Yak Kim, Hyuna Kim, Yong Hun Jang, Woochang Hwang, Junho K Hur, Young-Eun Kim, Sungmin Lim, Dong-Hye Ye, Hyun Ju Lee, Erich Cosmi
pmc-12653483.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/Objectives: Preterm infants are at risk for developmental delays due to immature brain development and increased sensitivity to environmental stress. Genetic factors, such as polymorphisms in *OXTR* rs2268490, *COMT* rs4818, and *GRIN2B*, may influence these vulnerabilities and affect neurodevelopment. Methods: We recruited 91 preterm infants (<35 weeks gestation) admitted to the NICU at Hanyang University Seoul Hospital between January 2020 and December 2022. Brain MRIs were conducted at term-equivalent age, and DNA samples were analyzed for SNPs.

pmc-13556912.title: Treatment gaps in osteoporosis care following recurrent fractures: a nationwide cohort study
pmc-13556912.creator: Hyun Jin Han, Miryoung Kim, Eyoung Wang, Min Ji Kim, Hae Sun Suh
pmc-13556912.description: Aim:This nationwide cohort study primarily aimed to descriptively characterize real-world treatment patterns, including treatment initiation, adherence, treatment duration and discontinuation of the first treatment drug, among patients who experienced a recurrent osteoporotic fracture.Materials & methods:This population-based, retrospective cohort study used data from the Health Insurance Review and Assessment Database of South Korea.
